nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What has contributed to the increase in atmospheric N2O emissions over the last four decades?
nodes.answer: The increase in atmospheric N2O emissions is mainly due to soil N2O emissions from agriculture.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Sustainable agriculture practices|No-till farming systems_qna_001
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What measures can help reduce global warming from agriculture?
nodes.answer: Global warming from agriculture can be reduced by increasing the storage of soil organic carbon and reducing methane (CH4) and nitrous oxide (N2O) emissions while increasing productivity.
